title: 咖啡罐
description: 3 PCS Glass Coffee Jars with Spoons & Wooden Tray, 30.4 oz 20.3 oz 13.5 oz Complete 3-Jar Set: Includes three ribbed glass storage jars, three wooden lids, three matching wooden spoons, and one coordinating tray, creating an organized countertop station for coffee, tea, sugar, and other dry ingredients Three Graduated Capacities: The set includes 13.5, 20.3, and 30.4 oz jars for storing different amounts of coffee beans, loose-leaf tea, sugar cubes, spices, candy, nuts, and snacks without using identical containers for every ingredient Silicone-Sealed Wood Lids: Each wooden lid features a silicone sealing ring that creates a snug closure to help protect dry ingredients from air and moisture while keeping the contents neatly covered between uses Individual Spoon Holders: Each jar comes with its own wooden spoon and a side-mounted holder, keeping the serving utensil close at hand while preventing it from being buried inside the contents or placed directly on the countertop Clear and Organized Display: The transparent ribbed glass makes stored ingredients and remaining quantities easy to identify, while the wooden tray keeps all three jars together on coffee bars, kitchen counters, pantry shelves, or beverage stations The scene features European‑style home interiors with bright lighting as the main element.
